segment: Industrial chay makers and frozen chay co-packers
current_protein_ingredient_spend: Import-dependent on TVP, SPC, SPI and gluten; share of the 54,000 t of China-shipped plant protein (2025) that goes to chay is unknown
switching_likelihood: High: every protein-dense local chay product uses imported protein; SMEs switch on price and supply security
required_price_and_spec: Landed price at or below Chinese TVP/SPC: USD 1.24/kg FOB (2025) plus freight; no duty under ACFTA or RCEP, so about USD 1.29 to 1.38 per kg landed (USD 1.35 to 1.44 if a 5% duty applied), about USD 2.0 to 2.1 per kg of protein; granules 4 to 7 mm and slices; water absorption and chew; bland; non-GMO; Halal for exporters; 20 to 25 kg bags; 12 month shelf life
ease_of_first_trial: Fast: owner-managed SMEs, simple bench trials
best_fit_novel_or_domestic_ingredient: Domestic TVP (soy or soy-gluten); later mung bean or rice textured protein
plausible_first_customers: An Nhien, Au Lac, Thoai An, LC Foods, SG Food, Thanh Dung; Cholimex and CJ Cau Tre chay lines; Vissan chay
source_ids: BUY-02; BUY-27; FORM-01; FORM-28; FTR-32; TIC-12
notes: Scores are our judgement from revealed use and firm type. Version 0.4: corrected 'plus freight and 5% MFN duty': Chinese product enters at 0%, so there is no tariff shelter. A soy extrusion line can serve about 12,800 t of textured-type imports (2025).

segment: Plant milks and adult nutrition drinks
current_protein_ingredient_spend: Pea protein at Vinamilk; whole soybeans at Vinasoy; nut pastes; imported proteins
switching_likelihood: Medium to high for non-soy proteins: soy-free is used as a selling point
required_price_and_spec: Pea protein imported at about USD 2 to 7/kg in bulk (China and US, 2025 shipments); solubility, low viscosity, UHT stability, neutral flavour; non-GMO, gluten-free, glyphosate-free documentation
ease_of_first_trial: Medium: large firms, long QA, high volumes once listed
best_fit_novel_or_domestic_ingredient: Rice or mung bean protein isolate (soy-free, local)
plausible_first_customers: Vinamilk (high-protein nut milk); Vinasoy (Veyo); Nutifood (Varna Life Sua Hat); TH true NUT
source_ids: BUY-09; BUY-15; BUY-16; BUY-17; BUY-19; FTR-32; FTR-02
notes: Highest willingness to pay among plant-protein buyers. Version 0.4: pea protein enters at 0% from China, France and Canada (US 3%), so the isolate band is unprotected; host drinks above 5 g total sugar per 100 ml may pay 8% excise from 2027 (10% from 2028) while dairy is exempt.

segment: Meat processors (gio, cha, sausage, pate, canned)
current_protein_ingredient_spend: Soy protein in 22 of 67 Vissan meat formulations; also gluten, milk protein, egg white; inclusion levels undisclosed (typically 1 to 3%)
switching_likelihood: Medium: price-led in value lines; premium lines market higher meat content
required_price_and_spec: SPI parity near USD 1.8 to 2.2/kg (about USD 2.0 to 2.4 per kg protein); gel strength, emulsification and water holding in fine pastes; bland; heat stable in retort; non-GMO documentation; a new extender must beat hydrated soy (about USD 2.6 to 2.8 per kg of protein), not lean meat
ease_of_first_trial: Medium: in-house R&D, but QA tightened after 2025 and 2026 scandals
best_fit_novel_or_domestic_ingredient: Soy-free binder (mung bean protein) or fungal biomass for texture in value lines; hybrid products
plausible_first_customers: Vissan; Masan MEATLife; Cholimex; CJ Cau Tre
source_ids: BUY-05; BUY-07; BUY-13; BUY-20; HXE-10; DIE-25
notes: Fungal biomass cannot beat SPI on cost per kg protein; it must win on function or label. Version 0.4: soy extension saves 14 to 16% of raw-material cost at 20% replacement at every hog price since 2019, so cost does not limit blends; identity, sensory ceilings (10 to 20% in fine emulsions, 30% in coarse mince) and trust do.

best_fit_novel_or_domestic_ingredient: Fungal biomass or yeast-derived flavour protein; mushroom-based chay seasonings
